method: StreamingLLM-style sink + recent-window KV eviction, position-preserving (original RoPE positions kept, no re-indexing)
hardware_scope: Apple Silicon GPU via MLX only; not CUDA, Ascend, phone or serving

data.construction: every row shows all 9 distinct dev passages: own passage at a seeded slot, others in seeded order; prompt length recorded per row (expected roughly 1.1k-1.4k tokens, not verified without the tokenizer)

eviction_point: once, after full-prompt prefill, before the first decode step
metric: lab/qa_metrics.py score(): normalized EM, reported overall, answerable (is_impossible=false) and impossible separately

correctness_gate.description: EvictedKVCache with budget >= prompt (no eviction) must reproduce native MLX greedy tokens exactly and logits within atol/rtol before any quality or timing run

timing.order: arms shuffled per repeat with seed
timing.measured: decode wall time after eviction (prefill identical across arms, excluded); eviction copy time recorded separately

adoption_gate.note: Frozen in this commit before any model run. Not changed after results. n_answerable=33, so one lost answer = 3.03 points and fails the answerable gate.

known_risks: sliding-window eviction can drop the answer passage; a negative result is expected and will be kept
logical KV bytes are buffer sizes, not measured device memory
41/74 rows are impossible questions; eviction may raise NO_ANSWER rate, which can inflate impossible-question EM
